prompt: Find the slope of the line through $(2, 1)$ and $(6, 4)$. Write it as a fraction.
hint: Slope $= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$. Keep the answer as a fraction.

hints.text: Slope $= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$. Keep the answer as a fraction.

explanation: Slope $= \frac{3}{4}$ — up $3$ for every $4$ across. A slope does not have to be a whole number!

alternativeExplanations.title: Gentle stairs
steps: From $(2,1)$ walk $4$ tiles across and climb only $3$ up to land on $(6,4)$.
Less than $1$ up per tile across: exactly $\frac{3}{4}$ up each tile.
